title: Waste draws attention at COP31 amid $480M methane commitment

sources.title: Waste draws attention at COP31 amid $480M methane commitment
sources.excerpt: Participating countries were unable to reach agreement on fossil fuel reductions at the annual conference. But zero waste became a priority, as did continued efforts to reduce methane from waste and other sources.

title: EPA seeks feedback on RCRA hazardous waste permitting reform

sources.title: EPA seeks feedback on RCRA hazardous waste permitting reform
sources.excerpt: The agency is soliciting comments on “all areas” of the permit process, including considerations for post-closure responsibilities, land sales and cost savings. Listening sessions are from Dec. 2-10.

sources.excerpt: Republic plans to pursue approval for broader uses of its postconsumer PP resins produced by Blue Polymers. Meanwhile, WM inked an annual 25-million pound PP offtake deal with PureCycle, a maker of food grade resin.
